summary: Frontend-only testing for 3 QSO Pocket improvements: password visibility toggles (login+register), CB/Ham callsign detection banner in Add QSO modal, and ADIF import accept attribute. All 10 requested features PASSED.

test_results.register_toggle_button_present: PASS - data-testid='toggle-password-register' found (requires selecting Ham/CB/SWL role card first to reach form)
test_results.admin_login: PASS - admin@example.com / admin123 logs in, dashboard loads, callsigns=7, total QSOs=10
test_results.cb_callsign_in_ham_logbook: PASS - typing '14CB001' in radioamateur logbook shows blue banner 'This callsign looks like a CB callsign.' with data-testid='logbook-suggestion'
test_results.ham_callsign_in_cb_logbook: PASS - after switching to CB via logbook-selector, typing 'F4ABC' shows blue banner 'This callsign looks like a ham radio callsign.'
test_results.cb_callsign_in_cb_logbook: PASS - typing '14CB001' in CB logbook shows NO banner
test_results.adif_accept_attribute: PASS - accept attribute = '.adi,.adif,.ADI,.ADIF,application/octet-stream,*/*' (includes */* for Android compatibility)
test_results.dashboard_still_works: PASS - dashboard renders with callsigns list, stats, admin button visible

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: ADIF import <input> uses id='adif-import-input' instead of data-testid. Consider adding data-testid for consistency with other elements, though functional accept attribute is correct.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 improvements verified working: (1) Eye/EyeSlash password toggle on login+register pages using Phosphor icons, (2) CB/Ham detection banner in AddQSOModal shows correctly bidirectional (CB in ham logbook, ham in CB logbook) with proper suppression when callsign matches logbook, (3) ADIF file input accept attribute includes '*/*' for Android compatibility. Register page requires clicking Ham/CB/SWL role card first before password field is visible.
